best_direction.core_claim: Do not start with the accomplishment. Start at the moment the student recognized something was wrong and changed course — and stay close to what happened next. best_direction.main_risk_if_written_poorly: If the essay describes character without a concrete moment of correction, it loses the specificity that makes it work.
